# Moosa Rezwani

> Personal website of Moosa Rezwani, an immunologist and computational biologist.

Moosa Rezwani is a PhD researcher in Biomedical and Pharmaceutical Sciences at the Université libre de Bruxelles. His work combines immunology and computational biology to study human γδ T cells in breast milk and the architecture of the TCR repertoire. More broadly, he investigates how T-cell function and receptor diversity shape immunity in health and disease.

## Profiles

* [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0001-6325-4444): Researcher identifier and publication record.
* [GitHub](https://github.com/moosa-r): Research software and code repositories.
* [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/moosa-rezwani/): Professional profile.

* [rbioapi documentation](https://rbioapi.moosa-r.com/): Documentation for rbioapi, an R interface to biological databases and web services.
* [rbioapi source code](https://github.com/moosa-r/rbioapi): Source code and development repository for rbioapi.
* [rbioapi on CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=rbioapi): Official CRAN package page.
